title: CORR-002: Keep modal open on delete error
description: When a delete fails, the error is set to error.value but the modal is immediately closed. The user cannot see the error message because it's displayed in a different context. The modal should stay open and display the error inline.

context.current_pattern: catch -> set error.value -> close modal immediately
context.issue: Modal closes before user can see error message
context.comparison: Jobs.vue keeps modal open on error for better UX

acceptance_criteria: Delete modal stays open when error occurs
Error message is visible in the modal
User can read the error before closing modal
User can retry delete or close modal on error
Success flow still closes modal immediately
Modal has error display section (inline or below buttons)

implementation_notes.fix_approach_2: Add showDeleteError state to track if error is visible
implementation_notes.template_change:
Add error display to modal template:
{{ deletingUser.error }}
implementation_notes.success_flow: On success: close modal and clear error
implementation_notes.error_flow: On error: set error on deletingUser, keep modal open

unit_test: Mock deleteUser API to return error
Trigger delete and verify modal stays open
Verify error message is set on component state
manual_test: Click delete button on a user
If API returns error (can mock in DevTools), verify:
- Can close modal without losing error display
ui_test: Verify error message displays with appropriate styling
Check error message is readable (font size, color contrast)
Verify error message is positioned in modal properly
Check modal buttons remain functional on error

rollback_plan: git revert <commit-hash> — isolated change to error handling in delete
notes: This improves error visibility and UX without breaking existing functionality. Success path unchanged; only error path improved. Modal template may need CSS class for error styling.
